name: Product discovery
description: Survey what exists today, prioritize opportunities with a stakeholder, and package approved ideas as pi start handoffs.

steps.objective: Read the product as it exists today — features, docs, configuration, and recent runs — and surface product opportunities grounded in evidence, not wishlists.
Work with the stakeholder to rank the opportunities (now / next / later / no), cut what does not hold up, and record what is approved to pursue.
Turn each approved backlog item into a task brief the conductor can start: goal, recommended workflow, facts, per-run step skips, and a copy-paste pi start command.
